item.title: Tiny Pores, Big Stories: Perforating MXenes for Through-Sheet Transport in Energy and Environmental Applications
item.description:

Accounts of Materials Research | ⭐ Review | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This Account establishes in-plane perforation as a design principle converting lamellar MXenes into through-sheet transport platforms. It unifies oxidative perforation routes, reveals a common oxidation-driven pore-formation pathway, and links transverse transport to gains in supercapacitors, batteries, deionization, and membranes. It also flags the stability–transport trade-off, positioning holey MXenes as transport-engineered 2D materials.
🏷 MXene · in-plane pores · through-sheet transport · holey MXene · ion diffusion

item.title: Interfacial Electric Field Engineering via Electrostatic Self-Assembled Heterostructure-Modified Separator for Stable Lithium Metal Batteries
item.description:
این مقاله با مهندسی میدان الکتریکی بین‌سطحی از طریق جداکننده اصلاح‌شده با هترواستراتور خودآرا، پایداری باتری‌های لیتیوم فلزی را بهبود می‌بخشد.
Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using electrostatic self-assembly to build a heterostructure-modified separator that engineers the interfacial electric field. This regulates lithium-ion flux and suppresses dendrite growth, enabling stable lithium metal batteries. Its significance is providing a scalable, low-cost strategy to improve safety and cycling life, advancing high-energy-density LMBs toward practical deployment.
🏷 lithium metal battery · separator modification · heterostructure · interfacial electric field · self-assembly

item.title: Tunable Nickel Sulfoselenides for Rechargeable Zn-Air Flow Batteries
item.description:
این مقاله نیکل سولفوسلنیدهای قابل تنظیم را برای باتری‌های جریان Zn-air معرفی می‌کند که می‌توانند ذخیره‌سازی انرژی در مقیاس شبکه را بهبود بخشند.
Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 Nickel sulfoselenides are tuned as bifunctional catalysts for rechargeable Zn-air flow batteries. By varying the S/Se ratio, the electronic structure and catalytic activity are optimized, enhancing oxygen reduction and evolution. This composition engineering yields improved round-trip efficiency and durability, offering a promising, earth-abundant electrode strategy for scalable grid-level energy storage.
🏷 Zn-air battery · nickel sulfoselenide · flow battery · oxygen electrocatalysis · grid storage
